title: Shortening the same URL twice creates duplicate slugs
body:
Every `POST /links` with the same URL creates a new slug.

Expected: if a link for the same (normalized) URL already exists, return the existing link instead of creating a new one (status 200 or 201). URLs that normalize to the same value — e.g. `https://Example.com/n` and `https://example.com/n` — count as the same. Different URLs still get different slugs.
